caption:
Riding the remote mountain biking trails in Costa Rica requires a different kind of presence. I design our routes along these old agricultural corridors, where the canopy closes overhead and the damp clay demands your full attention. It is demanding, honest riding—the kind I personally scout to ensure we only share the most rewarding paths. Experience the country from the saddle with My Adventure Costa Rica.
